note: City of Belmond RV park, just over an acre at 312 River Avenue South (US-69), within walking distance of stores, fuel and restaurants. A trail links it to River Park, which has canoe access to the Iowa River. --Claude
summary: Rate found: $20 flat (city page). Confirmed 19 sites (11 FHU, 5 pull-through, 8 W/E), tent area, modern toilet/shower building, dump. Season and booking are not on the city page. Not waterfront confirmed (river ~200 m west across a meadow, ~15-20 m wide). Pin fine.
flags: WATERFRONT (not waterfront confirmed): the Iowa River is about 15-20 m wide here on Esri imagery (creek-class by the ~30 m rule) and runs about 180-220 m west of the RV park, across an open meadow and a tree belt. The RV park is under canopy on US-69. No lead.
SEASON: stored year_round=false (note's 'Open ~Apr 15-Oct 15') is not stated on the city page; left alone, unverified.
